subject: general
question: In April 2025, which startup, selected by the Department of Science and Technology (DST) under the National Quantum Mission (NQM), has launched the world’s first platform — QShield — that enables seamless cryptography management?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**QNu Labs**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **QNu Labs** is an Indian quantum technology startup selected by the **Department of Science and Technology (DST)** under the **National Quantum Mission (NQM).**
 
• In **April 2025**, QNu Labs launched the **world’s first quantum platform** named **QShield**, which facilitates **seamless cryptography management.**
